title: 连接 RealTrace
description: 请输入您在 RealTrace 控制台创建的 API Key。凭证仅保存在本机 WorkBuddy 配置中，不会经过 WorkBuddy 云端。
description_en: Enter the API Key created in the RealTrace Console. The credential is stored only in your local WorkBuddy configuration and is not sent through WorkBuddy's cloud service.
docLabel_en: How to get an API Key?

fields.label: RealTrace API Key
fields.placeholder: 请输入以 sk- 开头的完整 API Key
fields.placeholder_en: Enter the complete API Key beginning with sk-
fields.description: 该凭证仅用于连接 RealTrace，并将写入 Authorization 请求头。
fields.description_en: Used only to connect to RealTrace and sent in the Authorization request header.
